hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/FWAToken pool that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps: buy fees are taken in FWAToken and swapped back to ETH via a nested pool swap, sell fees are taken in ETH, both routed to an owner-set address. Pool initialization and seed liquidity are gated to the token's one-shot launch flag, and external buys are restricted to an owner-managed allowlist until external trading is explicitly enabled.
